events.name: New Jersey Devils at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Mark Kastelic scored twice in the first period, Jeremy Swayman earned his second shutout of the season and the Boston Bruins clinched the top wild-card spot in the Eastern Conference with a 4-0 win over the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kastelic scores 2, Swayman posts shutout as Bruins stop Devils 4-0 to clinch East's top wild card

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Mark Jankowski scored the go-ahead goal in the third period, and the Carolina Hurricanes defeated the New York Islanders 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jankowski’s 3rd-period goal lifts Hurricanes past Islanders 2-1

headlines.description: — Matvei Michkov had a goal and two assists and Porter Martone had one goal to lead the playoff-bound Philadelphia Flyers to a 4-2 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michkov has a goal and 2 assists as the Flyers beat the Canadiens 4-2

events.name: Washington Capitals at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Alex Ovechkin had an assist on the go-ahead goal in what perhaps will be the final game of his record-breaking career and the Washington Capitals defeated the Columbus Blue Jackets 2-1 on Tuesday night in the season finale for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ovechkin gets assist in what could be his final game as the Capitals defeat the Blue Jackets 2-1

headlines.description: — Hunter Haight got his first career goal and rookie Jesper Wallstedt auditioned for action in the playoffs with 35 saves, as the Minnesota Wild finished their regular season by beating the Anaheim Ducks 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wallstedt makes 35 saves for Wild in a 3-2 win over the Ducks in a playoff tuneup for both teams

headlines.description: — Nick Schmaltz scored twice as the Utah Mammoth beat the Winnipeg Jets 5-3 on Tuesday night and secured the first wild-card spot in the Western Conference.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schmaltz scores 2 goals as Mammoth defeat Jets 5-3

headlines.description: — Gabriel Landeskog scored the go-ahead goal at 15:07 of the third period to lead the Colorado Avalanche to a 3-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Landeskog scores go-ahead goal to help the Avalanche to a 3-1 win over the Flames

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jimmy Snuggerud scored twice and assisted on both of Dylan Holloway's goals in the third period as the St. Louis Blues rallied from a three-goal deficit to beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 7-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jimmy Snuggerud scores twice, leads Blues back from 3-goal deficit to beat Penguins 7-5

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Jake DeBrusk scored his second goal of the game in overtime and the Vancouver Canucks beat the Los Angeles Kings 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeBrusk scores in overtime, gives Canucks a 4-3 victory over the Kings
